Thanks for the summary — that matches our notes. A few clarifying items before we take the CAIQ path: 

1) SOC 2 timing: when do you expect certification (Type II)? We need to understand if an audit report will be available during our procurement window (Q3).
2) Encryption: do you offer customer-managed keys (KMS) and full-disk + in-transit encryption? Any limitations for Hosted vs Dedicated/Private deployments?

Hi Asha —

Following up with concrete answers and the prefills you requested. I'll keep this short and action-focused.

Answers:
- SOC 2: We are currently in a Type II readiness window; our first Type II audit is scheduled for late August 2026 with an anticipated report available in September 2026. We can provide our SOC 2 Type I and controls evidence bundle today (executive summary attached).
- Encryption / KMS: We support in-transit TLS and at-rest encryption by default. Customer-managed keys (KMS integration) are available for Dedicated and Private deployments today; for Hosted customers we offer a bring-your-own-key path via our KMS integration (workbook available).
- Logs / Residency: Default logs/telemetry for Hosted are stored in US regions. We offer an EU-residency option as part of our Private deployment or via Dedicated contracts with EU region capacity — we can discuss scope for pilot.
- BAA: Redwood has a standard BAA template we can execute. Legal typically reviews the draft and then we sign; if you need an NDA/BAA before sharing specific PHI examples, say the word and we'll prioritize.

Attachments included (prefill stubs):
- redwood_soc2_exec_summary.pdf (high-level controls and timeline)
- redwood_caiq_prefill.xlsx (CAIQ prefills — marked with suggested answers)
- redwood_sig_prefill.csv (SIG-prefill as a fallback)

Proposed evidence timeline (for planning):
- Initial bundle (controls summary + CAIQ prefills + SOC1/Type I evidence): 2 business days after you confirm CAIQ
- Full evidence set (deeper artifacts requested in SIG/CAIQ): 3–4 weeks depending on scope and legal requests

Next steps I propose:
1) Asha confirms CAIQ (you indicated yes) — we'll prioritize the CAIQ prefills and send today.
2) Please introduce Ravi (security engineer) or share 2 windows for a 30-min technical sync this week or next.
3) If legal wants the BAA draft now, loop in your legal contact and we’ll route to our contracts team.
